OUR COMPANY
Uken builds games that people play for years. We believe in small, empowered teams with the autonomy to make their own decisions about how to delight our players.
Your browser does not support the video tag.
OUR JOURNEY: BUILDING GAMES THAT CONNECT
Uken's story began in 2009 with a simple idea: make games that people love. It all started with Game Wars, a breakout hit that set the stage for bigger dreams. In 2019, Uken expanded its vision, launching the cozy narrative experience Ava's Manor.
Partnering with Sony, Uken transformed legendary game shows like Who Wants to Be a Millionaire and Jeopardy! World Tour into mobile adventures enjoyed worldwide.
